title: fix: support en-dash and em-dash for time parsing
body:
This PR fixes a bug where time ranges using an en-dash (`–`) or em-dash (`—`) were not parsed correctly. This often happens on iOS/macOS keyboards or when copying text.

- Updated `split()` to use a regex `/[-–—]/`
- Added corresponding tests for en-dash, em-dash, and time without colon (e.g. `1300-1400`)

---
*🤖 Authored by Lango*
